scalars.scalar_value: Experience working within an incident (Unified) Command system utilized in managing emergency situations.

items.item_text: Must have valid, current 24 hour HAZWOPER certification.
Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Experience working within an incident (Unified) Command system utilized in managing emergency situations.
Experience working with wildlife, including capture and restraint of wild animal

Under direct guidance of the Command Staff/Team Coordinator as part of an official Incident Command System, applies acquired skills and knowledge of oil spill response to support response operations plans and activities related to spill response, including but not limited to reconnaissance, hazing, recovery, and field stabilization.
completion of all core training classes, all basic responder courses, and all Oiled wildlife specialist training through Oiled wildlife care Network.
training in para-veterinary animal Health care.
Skill to work as a team Member within the oil spill response structure.
Knowledge in the biological Sciences (ecology, wildlife Biology) and/@or equivalent training in an animal care field.
Skill in assessing and administering emergency healthcare to wildlife in field settings.
